title: Semantic Index Backbone — HNSW + SQLite (FINAL_SEGMENTS)
repo_context: Implement persistent local semantic indexing for CorpusView.FINAL_SEGMENTS using hnswlib + SQLite metadata mapping, and wire semantic lane retrieval to return EvidenceCards.

stories.title: Add semantic index artifact manifest + path helpers (pool-scoped, deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: A manifest file can be written and read back deterministically (round-trip) for the semantic index pool
Manifest includes (at minimum): pool/view identifier, embedding_dim, embedding model revision identifier, chunking policy identifier, and a schema version
A co-located pytest verifies manifest round-trip and that paths resolve under the existing assets root (no new global root)
stories.notes: Keep this mechanical and explicit. Avoid auto-reindex behavior here; just represent and validate state.

stories.title: Implement SQLite VectorMetadataStore (chunk_id ↔ label, slice queries by dossier/view)
acceptance_criteria: VectorMetadataStore can initialize its schema in a new sqlite file
Store supports: upsert chunk metadata, lookup by chunk_id, lookup by label, and list labels for (dossier_id, view/pool) to support replace-slice
A deterministic pytest uses a temp directory + temp sqlite file and verifies CRUD + slice label listing
stories.notes: Use chunk_id as the primary identity; labels are internal. Prefer simple schema + explicit versioning.

stories.title: Implement HnswVectorStore wrapper (create/load/save, add, knn_query, mark_deleted)
acceptance_criteria: HnswVectorStore can create an index with a configured embedding_dim and persist it to disk
After reload, knn_query returns the same top hit(s) for a deterministic small fixture
mark_deleted prevents deleted labels from returning as hits (verified by pytest)
stories.notes: Use cosine-equivalent behavior (normalize vectors + inner product) unless repo contract requires otherwise.

stories.title: Implement persistent VectorStore adapter using (HnswVectorStore + VectorMetadataStore) with chunk_id public IDs
acceptance_criteria: Existing semantic lane VectorStore public API continues to use chunk_id string IDs (no label leakage)
Upserting the same chunk_id twice does not produce duplicate retrievable IDs (deterministic behavior, verified by pytest)
Index build → save → load → query returns chunk_id hits (pytest)
stories.notes: Keep the contract compatible with existing retrieval code. If deletions require tombstones, document clearly in code.

stories.title: Add SemanticIndexBuilder for FINAL_SEGMENTS (append-only indexing for one dossier) with deterministic test using stubs
acceptance_criteria: A builder can index FINAL_SEGMENTS for a single dossier by enumerating corpus refs, chunking, embedding (stubbed), and writing to the persistent VectorStore
A pytest builds an index for a small synthetic dossier fixture and verifies a query returns at least one expected chunk_id
The test does not require a running server process or external network calls
stories.notes: Inject dependencies so tests can use a stub embedding provider and a minimal corpus fixture.

stories.title: Add replace-slice per dossier/view (tombstone old labels, rebuild slice) + deterministic test
acceptance_criteria: Replace-slice deletes/tombstones all previously indexed labels for (dossier_id, FINAL_SEGMENTS) before inserting rebuilt vectors
A pytest verifies that after replace-slice with changed content, stale hits no longer appear
stories.notes: Correctness-first: it is acceptable to accumulate tombstones; compaction is deferred.

stories.title: Wire semantic lane: query → vector hits → metadata → EvidenceCards (persistent index), with safe failure modes
acceptance_criteria: Semantic lane uses the persistent VectorStore for FINAL_SEGMENTS and returns EvidenceCards that include ref + selector for each hit
If the index is missing/uninitialized, the lane returns a safe empty result with an explicit reason (no crash)
A pytest exercises the lane against the synthetic indexed fixture and asserts evidence shape + provenance
stories.notes: Keep IDs as chunk_id externally. Missing metadata rows must be handled safely.

stories.title: Add manifest mismatch detection surfaced as explicit 'stale index / needs reindex' status (no silent auto-rebuild)
acceptance_criteria: If runtime embedding dim/model revision or chunking policy differs from the persisted manifest, the system surfaces an explicit stale status
Query does not silently rebuild the index when stale; it returns an explicit reason instead (verified by pytest)
stories.notes: This is an ethos alignment story: avoid surprise reindex side-effects from query paths.
